## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes (the pre-push hook runs it)
- [ ] Tests cover the change (`test/int`, or `test/e2e` for behaviour in the browser)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `## [Unreleased]` for `feat` / `fix` / `perf`
- [ ] Docs (`README.md`) updated if the public API or setup changed
